notes: Official Televic Conference datasheet (SKU 71.98.0504 / 71.98.2000), v1.0, 26 March 2021 — fetched from Televic's own regional site (televic-conference.fr). The unit is Plixus-powered over the RJ45 network cabling (48 VDC, 4.5 W) with no separate discrete power connector, so no power port is listed. The microphone input uses Televic's proprietary screw-lock connector (not literal XLR) — mapped to xlr3 as the closest taxonomy match. No bandwidth/link-speed grade is stated for the RJ45 Plixus network ports, so grade is omitted per instructions. Device is a tabletop/flush-mount delegate panel (discussion + simultaneous interpretation + voting), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. No "delegate/interpretation panel" category exists in the given type enum, so type is set to Other; category is set to audio as the closest fit (integrated speaker, mic input, headphone output, interpretation audio).

ports.name: Microphone
ports.note: Proprietary Televic screw-lock gooseneck mic connector (accepts D-MIC30SL/40SL/50SL, sold separately) — closest standard connector in the taxonomy, not a literal XLR.

ports.name: Network 1 (RJ45)
ports.note: Plixus network loop-through port; also delivers power to the unit (Plixus-powered, no separate power connector). Datasheet does not state a link-speed grade.

ports.name: Network 2 (RJ45)
ports.note: Second RJ45 for daisy-chain loop-through cabling. Datasheet does not state a link-speed grade.
